facts.fact: vertex_groups[...].add(indices, weight, 'REPLACE') writes one weight to many points in one call; a different weight per point needs one call per point (no foreach_set for vertex groups): times for 100,489 points
reading weights back: vg.weight(i) per point, or a loop over mesh.vertices[i].groups; both match what was written
a weight outside 0..1 is clamped on add (1.7 -> 1, -0.3 -> 0, the point still a member); ADD and SUBTRACT change an existing weight; weight() of a point not in the group raises RuntimeError
not_member: RuntimeError: Error: Vertex not in group

facts.fact: vg.remove([i]) takes a point out of the group
after_remove: RuntimeError: Error: Vertex not in group

facts.fact: vertex groups are not listed in mesh.attributes in 4.5 (they live in the mesh's deform layer)
the shader's Attribute node with attribute_name set to a vertex group's name renders its weight in Cycles (a 0 -> 1 ramp across x reads as one) but reads 0 everywhere in EEVEE
copied into a FLOAT POINT attribute, the same weights render in EEVEE through the Attribute node
a Displace modifier with vertex_group set moves each point by its weight (no texture: displacement 1 x weight)
object.vertex_group_normalize_all runs headless with the object active; a point in several groups then sums to 1
